It's quite straightforward to return an item if you change your mind, provided it meets our return policy criteria! We want to ensure you have peace of mind with your purchase.

Here’s a quick overview of how easy it is:

Return Window: You can initiate a return within 30 days of delivery. If you purchased Checkout+ Protection, this window is extended to 60 days.
Condition: Items must be in "like-new" condition, in their original boxes with all internal protective packaging, parts, pieces, and printed materials. They must also not be modified in any way.
Mattresses: Please note that mattresses have specific return requirements. For Premium & Comfort Mattresses, the outer box must be undamaged and fully sealed, and the mattress must remain in its original compressed, plastic-wrapped packaging inside the box. Once the outer box is opened, the mattress is no longer eligible for return. Deluxe Coil & Complete Slumber Mattresses and Changing Pads must also be unopened in their original packaging.
Initiating a Return: All returns must be processed through our online return portal. Once you complete the form and it's approved, a prepaid shipping label and instructions will be emailed to you.
Shipping Costs: If you purchased Checkout+, you'll receive a prepaid shipping label at no additional cost, covering your return shipping. If you did not purchase Checkout+, you will be responsible for the cost of the return shipping label and any associated return fees.

Once your return arrives at our California facility, please allow 3–5 business days for inspection. Upon approval, your refund will be issued to your original payment method.
